title: Timed decoding by a binary countdown
statement: For every finite Boolean word $x$, the countdown emitter computes the word consisting of $a2Value(x)$ copies of $1$ within $2|x|+2+(a2Value(x)+1)(2|x|+3)$ steps.
replaced: For every binary input $x$, the countdown emitter computes the all-ones word whose length is the little-endian value $v$ of $x$, within $2|x| + 2 + (v+1)(2|x|+3)$ steps.
